title: One-seed RESET-relative deployed-array direct-gradient threshold sweep
hypothesis: Suppressing small individual-conductance updates with fixed layer-specific p90, p95, or p99 absolute raw-gradient gates will improve terminal apparent-forward validation accuracy over the matched unthresholded direct-pulse control at at least one of the 0.1, 1, or 4 slow-pulse caps, while requesting fewer slow-array writes and producing fewer logical sign flips.
motivation: The completed unthresholded recovery pilot found only a transient +0.22-point apparent improvement at the 0.1 budget and terminal degradation at every direct-pulse budget. Its direct rule assigned nonzero probability to every nonzero gradient, so many weak updates consumed endurance and moved programmed four-cell contrasts. This is a remedial development study, not advancement to extra seeds or a formal array. It adapts the earlier measured-ReRAM threshold idea to a bidirectional deployed array by gating absolute raw gradients and retaining gradient sign for SET versus RESET.

completion_criteria: All nine arms must reuse byte-for-byte source deployment SHA-256 0b99f4dd73841a891993708bdace0ab508864e2e60e56620c165e3df99f006cd, source QAT checkpoint SHA-256 537681598b887d4d63c6429c7f7bee3a7082041215c09d6cb3c25947452f311a, teacher SHA-256 9a961a77628e365b54fdf59304ec7fddf46f1f4834c4c03cecea9c204f837f52, and IBM OM model SHA-256 3030e04d6205dc90d0894ac453d2c1c522dffdc004f69b9c6ab7eaf7ef4b8ba3.

Run exactly one seed for every p90, p95, and p99 by 0.1, 1, and 4 budget cell. Every arm runs all ten epochs and 34,380 minibatches, retains epoch 10 as primary, and reports the best intermediate epoch only descriptively.

Before any write, replay exactly 64 source-state training minibatches without consuming the training permutation or global RNG. For each stable parameter, compute a linear-interpolated quantile over strictly nonzero absolute raw gradients and freeze a strict absolute-gradient-greater-than threshold.
All nine arms must have identical per-parameter calibration sample digests. Thresholds must be byte-identical across budgets at a given percentile and monotone p90 <= p95 <= p99 in each parameter.

Do not redistribute suppressed updates. Freeze the exact probability scales 0.005644706616388747, 0.05644706616388745, and 0.2257882646555498 from unthresholded control reports f3ded58c814858f3bb1a6c8da282521e04ee8f3fdaebf9cba8ffacb1cc02a1c2, e9944e8ce1494e95369bc632be02a8ca60588be20d22ba59471d836290b2dbc1, and b36e5d09f648ad47b12c12c629587cd826587fc5460d3dac4f8aea55c3cc23b1. On the ungated calibration vectors, each frozen scale must reproduce its prior expected full-run cap before the gate is applied.

A retained eligible positive desired update requests one stochastic SET pulse and a retained eligible negative desired update requests one stochastic RESET pulse. Equality, sub-threshold magnitude, zero gradient, failed Bernoulli selection, or an exhausted whole-run cap holds the cell.

Every checkpoint and final recovery bundle must retain the numeric thresholds, percentile, calibration digest, probability-scale provenance, gate counters, pulse ledgers, two endpoint states, and exact resume RNG state. Each run must index a standalone direct-gradient calibration artifact.

The study is ready for review only after all nine runs pass full artifact-hash verification. Do not add seeds, choose a percentile or budget, release a held-out array, or update the experimental manifest from this one-seed development result.
analysis_plan: First prove exact initialization identity at 92.74 percent apparent-forward validation accuracy and 45.84 percent persistent-state diagnostic accuracy for all threshold arms and the three controls.

For each percentile-budget cell report terminal and best descriptive apparent accuracy, persistent diagnostic accuracy, KL, requested and state-changing pulses, SET/RESET split, unique cells, saturation, clipping, code crossings, logical sign flips, and calibrated gain.

Compare each arm only with the exact unthresholded direct-pulse control at the same cap from mnist-ibm-om-reset-relative-on-chip-recovery-pilot-20260825-v1. Report accuracy change, pulses saved, unique-cell change, and sign-flip change.

Report calibration thresholds and cumulative eligible/suppressed fractions separately for base.dense_weight.0 and base.dense_weight.1. Distinguish a fixed threshold's calibration percentile from its later dynamic eligibility fraction.
Treat terminal epoch 10 as primary. A transient improvement with terminal degradation is an early-stopping diagnostic, not a successful fixed ten-epoch protocol.
This one stochastic seed can diagnose whether thresholding is viable and how it changes cost, but cannot establish a method ranking or justify formal held-out deployment.
